_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% breakout rate over 7 days makes HOLD the graded base-rate call; Disbelief is the lean if the coil resolves upward, but there is no breaker visible yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls Disbelief with HOLD direction; narrative implies upward squeeze but does not name a phase; consensus leans to analyst's Disbelief as the adjacent-rung target while holding direction neutral
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows break above 20 with funding staying below 0.008%, signaling Hope transition
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding spikes above 0.01% with 30d momentum accelerating past 60 while ETF flows remain sub-10 — leverage excess invalidating the hold
